rca_of_issue: USER BUG: 'Passwords not working'. ROOT CAUSE: The Supabase project host wzshjedcbkygohcpytgf.supabase.co auto-paused after ~1 week of free-tier inactivity, so its DNS resolves nowhere from the container (curl exit 6). Because AuthContext previously initialised `mode` to `SUPABASE_CONFIGURED ? 'supabase' : 'legacy'` and SUPABASE_CONFIGURED is true (anon key + URL present in .env), the login screen defaulted to Supabase → `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword` threw 'Failed to fetch' / TypeError → user saw 'Passwords not working'. REPRODUCTION: (1) clear localStorage, (2) load app with EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL pointing at a paused project, (3) enter valid credentials → login fails. FIX APPLIED (main agent) & VERIFIED (this iteration): AuthContext.tsx now defaults to 'legacy' and the bootstrap useEffect ignores a persisted 'supabase' AsyncStorage value, so users are never trapped on the broken flow. The Supabase toggle pill on the login screen still lets users opt back in — attempted logins in Supabase mode surface a friendly 'Can't reach the server. Check your connection.' banner instead of crashing. MITIGATION for user: unpause the Supabase project in the Supabase dashboard, then tap the pill on the login screen to switch back to Supabase mode.
